# Perform basic analyses, output figures and tables for Survey data (use for 2026 and later)

# Use modelled means

``` {r BasicStats}
### Set Project Group order to display
ProjectGroupOrder <- c("Intertidal", "Historic Uncultched", "RESTORE-2017", "NFWF-2021",
                       "NFWF-2024", "NFWF-2024 Pilot", "NFWF-2024 General", "NFWF-2024 General Adjusted")
### Limit data to March through June samples to reduce seasonal bias and Remove Baywide data to reduce spatial bias
ShellHeights_1 <- ShellHeights_ALL %>%
  filter(!str_detect(StationName, "Baywide")) %>%
  # remove erroneous samples from NFWF-2024 General where sampling occurred where no cultching had occurred
  filter(!str_detect(QuadratID, "ABSRVY_20260613_1_0525_1")) %>%
  filter(month(TripDate) > 02 & month(TripDate) < 07)

Quadrats_1 <- Quadrats_ALL %>%
  filter(!str_detect(StationName, "Baywide")) %>%
  # remove erroneous samples from NFWF-2024 General where sampling occurred where no cultching had occurred
  filter(!str_detect(QuadratID, "ABSRVY_20260613_1_0525_1")) %>%
  filter(month(TripDate) > 02 & month(TripDate) < 07)

### Provides how many were measured for each size class for each quadrat
SHMeasures <- ShellHeights_1 %>%
  group_by(QuadratID) %>%
  summarize(TotalNumMeasured = sum(!is.na(ShellHeight)),
            Count_Spat_1_to_30 = sum(ifelse(ShellHeight >= 1 & ShellHeight <= 30, 1, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
            Count_Seed_31_to_75 = sum(ifelse(ShellHeight >= 31 & ShellHeight <= 75, 1, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
            Count_Legal_76_plus = sum(ifelse(ShellHeight >= 76, 1, 0), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

### Provide stats for how many live oysters there were in each quadrat, by size class
QuadStats_ <- left_join(Quadrats_1, SHMeasures, by = c("QuadratID")) %>% #Change QuadStats_ to QuadStats when 2025 data is complete
  mutate(
    Num_Spat_1_to_30 = if_else(TotalNumMeasured == 0, 0, (Count_Spat_1_to_30 * NumLive) / TotalNumMeasured),
    Num_Seed_31_to_75 = if_else(TotalNumMeasured == 0, 0, (Count_Seed_31_to_75 * NumLive) / TotalNumMeasured),
    Num_Legal_76_plus = if_else(TotalNumMeasured == 0, 0, (Count_Legal_76_plus * NumLive) / TotalNumMeasured)) %>%
  select(-starts_with("Count_")) # Remove Count columns as they are no longer needed

# remove intermediate data frames
# rm(ShellHeights_ALL, ShellHeights_1, Quadrats_ALL, Quadrats_1)



# Prep data frame for creating SH distribution histogram for ALL Years
SizeClasses_ALL <- ShellHeights_1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(ShellHeight)) %>%
  mutate(ShellHeightBin = cut(ShellHeight, 
                              breaks = c(0, 30, 75, 200),
                              right = TRUE,
                              include.lowest = TRUE)) %>% # puts measures in 3 bins
  group_by(Year, ProjectGroup) %>%
  mutate(ProjectTotal = n()) %>%
  group_by(ProjectGroup, Year, ShellHeightBin, ProjectTotal) %>%
  summarise(ProjectNumberMeasured = n()) %>%
  mutate(ProportionMeasured = (ProjectNumberMeasured / ProjectTotal),
         Year = factor(Year),
         ShellHeightBin = factor(ShellHeightBin,
                                 levels = c("(75,200]", "(30,75]", "[0,30]" )   # <-- order from bottom to top
    ))

SizeClasses_ALL$ShellHeightBin <- forcats::fct_recode(SizeClasses_ALL$ShellHeightBin,
  "Spat (1–30 mm)"    = "[0,30]",
  "Seed (31–75 mm)"   = "(30,75]",
  "Legal (>=76 mm)"  = "(75,200]"
)

maxSH <- max(ShellHeights_1$ShellHeight, na.rm = TRUE)




# Prep data frame for creating SH distribution histogram for PROJECT YEAR
ShellHeightsReportYrY <- ShellHeights_1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(ShellHeight),
  Year == ReportYear) %>%
  mutate(ShellHeightBin = cut(ShellHeight, 
                              breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max(ShellHeight, na.rm = TRUE)) + 5, by = 5),
                              right = TRUE,
                              include.lowest = TRUE)) %>% # puts measures in 5 mm bins
  group_by(ProjectGroup) %>%
  mutate(ProjectTotal = n()) %>%
  group_by(ProjectGroup, ShellHeightBin, ProjectTotal) %>%
  summarise(ProjectNumberMeasured = n()) %>%
  mutate(PercentMeasured = (ProjectNumberMeasured / ProjectTotal) * 100)

# Determine number of oysters measured during ReportYear
ShellHeightsReportYr <- ShellHeights_1 %>%
  filter(Year == ReportYear,
         !is.na(ShellHeight)) 
# Determine size of largest oyster measure during ReportYear 
maxSH <- max(ShellHeightsReportYr$ShellHeight, na.rm = TRUE)
```

``` {r NFWF-2024 General Explore, eval = FALSE}
# Exploring the NFWF-2024 General data to see if TotalWeight, NumLive, and ShellHeight data was affected by the 2026 Easthole Mortality Event.
### 
# Findings: TotalWeight differences were significant, but just barely, so will be treated together. NumLive differences were NOT significant, so will be treated together. ShellHeight differences were HIGHLY significant, so will not be treated together.
###

# Filter data frames for basic stats
Qexplore <- QuadStats %>%
  filter(ProjectGroup == "NFWF-2024 General")
SHexplore <- ShellHeights_1 %>%
  filter(ProjectGroup == "NFWF-2024 General")

# Total Weight Summary by station name and Overall
TWstation_summary <- Qexplore %>%
  group_by(StationName) %>%
  summarise(
    meanTW   = mean(TotalWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_TW    = sd(TotalWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    medianTW = median(TotalWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    maxTW    = max(TotalWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    minTW    = min(TotalWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    meanNL   = mean(NumLive, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_NL    = sd(NumLive, na.rm = TRUE),
    medianNL = median(NumLive, na.rm = TRUE),
    maxNL    = max(NumLive, na.rm = TRUE),
    minNL    = min(NumLive, na.rm = TRUE))
              
TWoverall_summary <- Qexplore %>%
  summarise(
    StationName = "Overall",
    meanTW   = mean(TotalWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_TW    = sd(TotalWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    medianTW = median(TotalWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    maxTW    = max(TotalWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    minTW    = min(TotalWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    meanNL   = mean(NumLive, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_NL    = sd(NumLive, na.rm = TRUE),
    medianNL = median(NumLive, na.rm = TRUE),
    maxNL    = max(NumLive, na.rm = TRUE),
    minNL    = min(NumLive, na.rm = TRUE))

# Combine both summaries into one table
TW_report <- bind_rows(TWstation_summary, TWoverall_summary)

# ShellHeight Summary by station name
SHstation_summary <- SHexplore %>%
  group_by(StationName) %>%
  summarise(
    meanSH   = mean(ShellHeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_SH    = sd(ShellHeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    medianSH = median(ShellHeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    maxSH    = max(ShellHeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    minSH    = min(ShellHeight, na.rm = TRUE))
              
SHoverall_summary <- SHexplore %>%
  summarise(
    StationName = "Overall",
    meanSH   = mean(ShellHeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_SH    = sd(ShellHeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    medianSH = median(ShellHeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    maxSH    = max(ShellHeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    minSH    = min(ShellHeight, na.rm = TRUE))

# Combine both summaries into one table
SH_report <- bind_rows(SHstation_summary, SHoverall_summary)

# Combine both reports into a single FINAL Report & delete intermediate
FINAL_report_NFWF2024General <- left_join(TW_report, SH_report, by = "StationName")
rm(TWstation_summary, TWoverall_summary, TW_report, SHstation_summary, SHoverall_summary, SH_report)

# Determine if Cat Point and Easthole data is statistically different
# Total Weight
# Check if variances are equal
var_testTW <- var.test(TotalWeight ~ StationName, data = Qexplore)
print(var_testTW)
# Since variances are equal (p = 0.433), perform t-test
t_test_equalTW <- t.test(TotalWeight ~ StationName, data = Qexplore, var.equal = TRUE)
print(t_test_equalTW)
# p = 0.044, which is statistically significant, but just barely, no data filtering needed

# NumLive
# Check if variances are equal
var_testNL <- var.test(NumLive ~ StationName, data = Qexplore)
print(var_testNL)
# Since variances are equal (p = 0.191), perform t-test
t_test_equalNL <- t.test(NumLive ~ StationName, data = Qexplore, var.equal = TRUE)
print(t_test_equalNL)
# p = 0.931, which is NOT statistically significant, no data filtering needed

# Check if variances are equal
var_testSH <- var.test(ShellHeight ~ StationName, data = SHexplore)
print(var_testSH)
# Since variances ARE NOT equal (p < 0.001), perform Welch's t-test, which is the safer default in R
t_test_welchSH <- t.test(ShellHeight ~ StationName, data = SHexplore, var.equal = FALSE)
print(t_test_welchSH)
# p < 0.001, which is HIGHLY statistically significant, These should not be treated together
```

``` {r TotalWeight Model selection INTERTIDAL, eval = FALSE}

### Intertidal Model ###
## Choose distribution family
TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ 1, 
                      family = Gamma(link = "log"), 
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Intertidal"))
TotalWeight_Intertidal_gaussian <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ 1, 
                      family = gaussian(link = "log"), 
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Intertidal"))
# Check goodness of fit
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Intertidal_gaussian, n = 1000, plot = T)
AIC(TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma, TotalWeight_Intertidal_gaussian)
## Gamma has better AIC and residuals, however KS, Dispersion, and Within group tests fail

## Add dispersion
TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma_1 <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ 1, 
                      family = Gamma(link = "log"), 
                      dispformula = ~ 1,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Intertidal"))
TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma_section <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ 1, 
                      family = Gamma(link = "log"), 
                      dispformula = ~ SectionName,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Intertidal"))
# Check goodness of fit
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma_1, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma_section, n = 1000, plot = T)
AIC(TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma, TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma_1, TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma_section)
## Including a dispersion term does NOT improve fit

## Add FixedLocation as a fixed or random effect
TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma_fixed <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ FixedLocationID, 
                      family = Gamma(link = "log"), 
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Intertidal"))
TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma_random <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ 1 + (1 | FixedLocationID), ### BEST
                      family = Gamma(link = "log"), 
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Intertidal"))
# Check goodness of fit
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma_fixed, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma_random, n = 1000, plot = T)
AIC(TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma, TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma_fixed, TotalWeight_Intertidal_gamma_random)
## Fixed effect improved fit, but KS, Levene, and Within-group test fail. All tests pass with random

```

``` {r TotalWeight Model selection HISTORIC, eval = FALSE}
### Historic Model ###
## Choose distribution family
TotalWeight_Historic_gamma <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ 1, 
                      family = Gamma(link = "log"), 
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
TotalWeight_Historic_gaussian <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ 1, 
                      family = gaussian(link = "identity"), 
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
# Check goodness of fit
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Historic_gamma, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Historic_gaussian, n = 1000, plot = T)
AIC(TotalWeight_Historic_gamma, TotalWeight_Historic_gaussian)
## Gamma has better AIC and residuals, however KS, Dispersion, and Within group tests fail

## Add dispersion
TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_1 <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ 1, 
                      family = Gamma(link = "log"), 
                      dispformula = ~ 1,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_section <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ 1, 
                      family = Gamma(link = "log"), 
                      dispformula = ~ SectionName,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
# Check goodness of fit
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_1, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_section, n = 1000, plot = T)
AIC(TotalWeight_Historic_gamma, TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_1, TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_section)
## Add dispersion did't help AIC or residuals

## Add effects
TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_fixed_y <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ factor(Year) + FixedLocationID, 
                      family = Gamma(link = "log"),
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_random_y <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ factor(Year) + (1 | FixedLocationID), # BEST
                      family = Gamma(link = "log"),
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_fixed_ys <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ factor(Year) + SectionName + FixedLocationID, 
                      family = Gamma(link = "log"),
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_random_ys <- glmmTMB(TotalWeight ~ factor(Year) + SectionName + (1 | FixedLocationID), 
                      family = Gamma(link = "log"),
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_fixed_y, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_random_y, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_fixed_ys, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_random_ys, n = 1000, plot = T)
AIC(TotalWeight_Historic_gamma, TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_fixed_y, TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_random_y,
    TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_fixed_ys, TotalWeight_Historic_gamma_random_ys)
## Adding SectionName didn't improve fit, Adding FixedLocation as a random (not fixed) effect helps and allows us to make larger generalizations

```


``` {r TotalWeight Models and Dataframes}
###############
### Create dataframes to store values for plots and tables 
###############

###############
### INTERTIDAL
# Generate Modeled Means, CI, and SE
# ggpredict needed to extract values of Random effects 
TotalWeightStats_Intertidal_modeled <- ggpredict(TotalWeight_Intertidal, 
                                                 terms = "FixedLocationID", type = "random") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(FixedLocationID = x,
         TotalWeightMean_modeled = predicted,
         TotalWeightLower_modeled = conf.low,
         TotalWeightUpper_modeled = conf.high) %>%
  mutate(TotalWeightMeanDensity_modeled = round((TotalWeightMean_modeled * 4), 1),
         TotalWeightLowerDensity_modeled = round((TotalWeightLower_modeled * 4), 1),
         TotalWeightUpperDensity_modeled = round((TotalWeightUpper_modeled * 4), 1)) %>%
  select(-group) %>%
  mutate(TotalWeightUpperDensity_modeled = case_when(
    TotalWeightMean_modeled <= 0 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ TotalWeightUpperDensity_modeled)) %>%
  left_join(FixedLocations1, by="FixedLocationID") %>%
  arrange(StationNumber) 
# Generate raw mean and SD
TotalWeightStats_Intertidal_RAW <- QuadStats %>%
  filter(ProjectGroup == "Intertidal") %>%
  group_by(FixedLocationID,
           StationNumber) %>%
  summarise_ALL() %>%
  arrange(StationNumber) %>%
  select(-matches("Num"))
# Combine into single table and remove intermediate dataframes
TotalWeightStats_Intertidal_ALL <- left_join(TotalWeightStats_Intertidal_modeled, 
                              TotalWeightStats_Intertidal_RAW, 
                              by = c("FixedLocationID")) 
rm(TotalWeightStats_Intertidal_modeled, TotalWeightStats_Intertidal_RAW)

###############
### SUBTIDAL
# Generate Modeled Means, CI, and SE
# emmeans needed to extract values of Random effects
TotalWeightStats_Historic <- emmeans(TotalWeight_Historic, ~ Year, type = "response") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(ProjectGroup = "Historic Uncultched") 

TotalWeightStats_RESTORE_2017 <- emmeans(TotalWeight_RESTORE_2017, ~ Year, type = "response") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(ProjectGroup = "RESTORE-2017")

TotalWeightStats_NFWF_2021 <- emmeans(TotalWeight_NFWF_2021, ~ Year, type = "response") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(response = emmean) %>%
  mutate(ProjectGroup = "NFWF-2021") 

TotalWeightStats_NFWF_2024 <- emmeans(TotalWeight_NFWF_2024, ~ ProjectGroup, type = "response") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(Year = 2026) 

TotalWeightStats_Subtidal_modeled <- bind_rows(TotalWeightStats_Historic, 
                                               TotalWeightStats_RESTORE_2017,
                                               TotalWeightStats_NFWF_2021,
                                               TotalWeightStats_NFWF_2024) %>%
  rename(TotalWeightMean_modeled = response,
         TotalWeightLower_modeled = asymp.LCL,
         TotalWeightUpper_modeled = asymp.UCL) %>%
  mutate(TotalWeightMeanDensity_modeled = round((TotalWeightMean_modeled * 4), 1),
         TotalWeightLowerDensity_modeled = round((TotalWeightLower_modeled * 4), 1),
         TotalWeightUpperDensity_modeled = round((TotalWeightUpper_modeled * 4), 1)) %>%
  select(-df) %>%
  mutate(TotalWeightUpperDensity_modeled = case_when(
    TotalWeightMean_modeled <= 0 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ TotalWeightUpperDensity_modeled))

# Generate raw mean and SD
TotalWeightStats_Subtidal_RAW <- QuadStats %>%
  filter(ProjectGroup != "Intertidal") %>%
  group_by(ProjectGroup,
           Year) %>%
  summarise_ALL() %>%
  arrange(ProjectGroup, Year) %>%
  select(-matches("Num"))

# Combine into single table and remove intermediate dataframes
TotalWeightStats_Subtidal_ALL <- left_join(TotalWeightStats_Subtidal_modeled, 
                              TotalWeightStats_Subtidal_RAW, 
                              by = c("Year", "ProjectGroup")) 
rm(TotalWeightStats_Historic, TotalWeightStats_RESTORE_2017, 
   TotalWeightStats_NFWF_2021, TotalWeightStats_NFWF_2024,
   TotalWeightStats_Subtidal_modeled, TotalWeightStats_Subtidal_RAW)
```

``` {r NumLive Model selection INTERTIDAL, eval = FALSE}
### Intertidal Model ###
## Choose distribution family
NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2 <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ 1, 
                      family = nbinom2, 
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Intertidal"))
NumLive_Intertidal_poisson <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ 1, 
                      family = poisson, 
                      ziformula = ~1,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Intertidal"))
# Check goodness of fit
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Intertidal_poisson, n = 1000, plot = T)
AIC(NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2, NumLive_Intertidal_poisson)
## nbinom2 has FAR better AIC and residuals, however KS, Dispersion, and Within group tests fail

## Add dispersion
NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2_1 <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ 1, 
                      family = nbinom2, 
                      ziformula = ~ 1,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Intertidal"))
NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2_section <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ 1, 
                      family = nbinom2, 
                      ziformula = ~ SectionName,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Intertidal"))
# Check goodness of fit
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2_1, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2_section, n = 1000, plot = T)
AIC(NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2, NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2_1, NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2_section)
## Including a dispersion term does NOT improve fit

## Add FixedLocation as a fixed or random effect
NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2_fixed <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ FixedLocationID, 
                      family = nbinom2, 
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Intertidal"))
NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2_random <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ 1 + (1 | FixedLocationID), ### BEST
                      family = nbinom2, 
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Intertidal"))
# Check goodness of fit
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2_fixed, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2_random, n = 1000, plot = T)
AIC(NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2, NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2_fixed, NumLive_Intertidal_nbinom2_random)
## Fixed effect improved AIC, but Within-group test fail. All tests pass and better fit with random
```

``` {r NumLive Model selection HISTORIC, eval = FALSE}
### Historic Model ###
## Choose distribution family
NumLive_Historic_nbinom2 <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ 1, 
                      family = nbinom2, 
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
NumLive_Historic_poisson <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ 1, 
                      family = poisson, 
                      ziformula = ~1,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
# Check goodness of fit
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Historic_nbinom2, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Historic_poisson, n = 1000, plot = T)
AIC(NumLive_Historic_nbinom2, NumLive_Historic_poisson)
## nbinom2 has better AIC and residuals, however Dispersion test fails

## Add dispersion
NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_1 <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ 1, 
                      family = nbinom2, 
                      dispformula = ~ 1,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_section <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ 1, 
                      family = nbinom2, 
                      dispformula = ~ SectionName,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
# Check goodness of fit
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_1, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_section, n = 1000, plot = T)
AIC(NumLive_Historic_nbinom2, NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_1, NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_section)
## Add dispersion didn't help AIC or residuals

## Add effects
NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_fixed_y <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ factor(Year) + FixedLocationID, 
                      family = nbinom2,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_random_y <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ factor(Year) + (1 | FixedLocationID), 
                      family = nbinom2,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_fixed_ys <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ factor(Year) + SectionName + FixedLocationID, 
                      family = nbinom2,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_random_ys <- glmmTMB(NumLive ~ factor(Year) + SectionName + (1 | FixedLocationID), # BEST
                      family = nbinom2,
                      data = subset(QuadStats, ProjectGroup == "Historic Uncultched"))
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_fixed_y, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_random_y, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_fixed_ys, n = 1000, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_random_ys, n = 1000, plot = T)
AIC(NumLive_Historic_nbinom2, NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_fixed_y, NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_random_y,
    NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_fixed_ys, NumLive_Historic_nbinom2_random_ys)
## Adding SectionName did improve fit, Adding FixedLocation as a random (not fixed) effect helps and allows us to make larger generalizations
```

``` {r NumLegal Stats}
## Generate raw mean and SD
# Determine which stations have enough legal oysters to merit inclusion in the modeling process
# For this we will only include stations whose raw mean density is greater than 11.1 legal oyster/m2 OR 200 bags per acre
NumLegalStats_RAW <- QuadStats %>% # Determine raw mean per quadrat 
  filter(Year == ReportYear) %>%
  group_by(FixedLocationID,
           StationNumber) %>%
  summarise_ALL() %>%
  arrange(StationNumber) %>%
  select(-matches("Weight"),
         -matches("Live"),
         -matches("Drill"))
NumLegal_NoModel <- NumLegalStats_RAW %>%
  filter(NumLegalDensityMean_raw < 11.1)
NumLegal_YesModel <- NumLegalStats_RAW %>%
  filter(NumLegalDensityMean_raw >= 11.1)

# Create data frame containing only NumLegal data that will be modeled.
NumLegal_QuadStats <- QuadStats %>%
  select(QuadratID, FixedLocationID, TripDate, StationName, StationNumber, ParcelName, StationNameNumber, ProjectGroup,
         Year, NumLegal, Comments) %>%
  filter(Year == ReportYear) %>%
  filter(FixedLocationID %in% NumLegal_YesModel$FixedLocationID)

```

``` {r NumLegal Model selection, eval = FALSE}
# Figure out which data distribution to use
# ALL
hist(NumLegal_QuadStats$NumLegal)
# negative binomial, range 0 - 120, peak at 0

# Each FixedLocationID
for (id in unique(NumLegal_QuadStats$FixedLocationID)) {
  hist(
    subset(NumLegal_QuadStats, FixedLocationID == id)$NumLegal,
    main = paste("FixedLocationID:", id),
    xlab = "NumLegal"
  )
}
# A variety of distributions including normal and negative binomial


### Testing pooled vs. reef-specific means
# Model A (pooled)
m_pooled <- glmmTMB(NumLegal ~ 1,
                    family = nbinom2,
                    data = NumLegal_QuadStats)
# Model B (reef-specific means)
m_Reef_Specific <- glmmTMB(NumLegal ~ FixedLocationID,
                     family = nbinom2,
                     data = NumLegal_QuadStats)
# Model C (ProjectGroup-specific means)
m_Project_Specific <- glmmTMB(NumLegal ~ ProjectGroup,
                     family = nbinom2,
                     data = NumLegal_QuadStats)
# Compared
anova(m_pooled, m_Reef_Specific, m_Project_Specific)
#### Results indicate adding ProjectGroup massively improved model fit (ΔAIC = 234, p < 0.001). Adding reef-specific means improved model fit even more (ΔAIC = 279, p < 0.001) Thus models for each Reef were used.

### Testing to see if zero inflation varies strongly among reef
## Without zero inflation:
m0 <- glmmTMB(NumLegal ~ FixedLocationID,
              ziformula = ~0,
              family = nbinom2,
              data = NumLegal_QuadStats)
# With zero inflation:
mzi <- glmmTMB(NumLegal ~ FixedLocationID,
               ziformula = ~1,
               family = nbinom2,
               data = NumLegal_QuadStats)
# Compare:
anova(m0, mzi)
#### Results indicate adding reef-specific zero inflation massively improved model fit (ΔAIC = 44, p < 0.001).
#### Manual checking revealed that there are zero values in NumLegal, thus zero-inflation may be necessary

#######################################################
### Model Selection per FixedLocationID (Reef)
#######################################################

# 0391
m_0391_nb <- glmmTMB(NumLegal ~ 1, dispformula = ~ 1, family = nbinom2, ziformula = ~ 0,
                     data = subset(NumLegal_QuadStats, FixedLocationID == "0391")) ### BEST
m_0391_nb_zi <- glmmTMB(NumLegal ~ 1, dispformula = ~ 1, family = nbinom2, ziformula = ~ 1,
                     data = subset(NumLegal_QuadStats, FixedLocationID == "0391"))
m_0391_po <- glmmTMB(NumLegal ~ 1, dispformula = ~ 1, family = poisson, ziformula = ~ 0,
                     data = subset(NumLegal_QuadStats, FixedLocationID == "0391"))
m_0391_po_zi <- glmmTMB(NumLegal ~ 1, dispformula = ~ 1, family = poisson, ziformula = ~ 1,
                     data = subset(NumLegal_QuadStats, FixedLocationID == "0391"))
# Check goodness of fit
AIC(m_0391_nb, m_0391_nb_zi, m_0391_po, m_0391_po_zi)
simulateResiduals(m_0391_nb, n = 1000, plot = T)
## nbinom2, no zero inflation has good fit

m_0510_nb_zi <- glmmTMB(NumLegal ~ 1, dispformula = ~ 1, family = nbinom2, ziformula = ~ 1,
                     data = subset(NumLegal_QuadStats, FixedLocationID == "0510")) 
m_0510_po <- glmmTMB(NumLegal ~ 1, dispformula = ~ 1, family = poisson, ziformula = ~ 0,
                     data = subset(NumLegal_QuadStats, FixedLocationID == "0510"))
m_0510_po_zi <- glmmTMB(NumLegal ~ 1, dispformula = ~ 1, family = poisson, ziformula = ~ 1,
                     data = subset(NumLegal_QuadStats, FixedLocationID == "0510"))
# Check goodness of fit
AIC(m_0510_nb, m_0510_nb_zi, m_0510_po, m_0510_po_zi)
simulateResiduals(m_0510_nb, n = 1000, plot = T)
## nbinom2, no zero inflation has good fit
```

### Leaving this in for using the column names and captions

``` {r NumLegalStats for Tables}

# Summary Table for Report
NumLegalStats_TABLE <- NumLegalStats_ALL %>%
  filter(!is.na(NumLegalMean_modeled)) %>%
  select(FixedLocationID, 
         ProjectGroup,
         StationNumber,
         StationNameNumber,
         ParcelArea,
         NumLegalLowerDensity_modeled,
         LowerBagsPerAcre, # Calculated from LCL 
         HarvestableBags) %>% # Estimated Harvestable Bags (10% of Total bags)
  arrange(ProjectGroup,
          StationNumber) %>%
  select(-StationNumber)

kable(NumLegalStats_TABLE,
      digits = 1,
      col.names = c("FixedLocationID", "Project", "Station Name", "Reef Acreage",
      "Modeled Mean Density (LCL 95%)", "Estimated Bags per Acre (LCL 95%)", "Estimated Harvestable Bags (LCL 95%)"),
      caption = "Modeled Mean Densities of legal-sized oysters (≥76 mm shell height) on reefs sampled in 2024. Density is expressed in number of legal-sized oysters per square meter. LCL = Lower Confidence Limit. NA indicates reef densities do not meet the required 400 bags per acre threshold for harvest. Reefs with a raw mean density at or below 8 legal-size oysters/m² (144 bags/acre) were not modeled. Raw and modeled mean densities for all reefs sampled available in Appendix A. ")

# Summary Table for the Appendix
NumLegalStats_TABLE_appendix <- NumLegalStats_ALL %>%
  select(FixedLocationID, 
         ProjectGroup,
         N,
         StationNumber,
         StationNameNumber,
         ParcelArea,
         NumLegal_76plus_DensityMean_raw,
         NumLegal_76plus_DensitySD_raw,
         NumLegalMeanDensity_modeled,
         NumLegalLowerDensity_modeled,
         NumLegalUpperDensity_modeled) %>%
  arrange(ProjectGroup,
          StationNumber) %>%
  select(-StationNumber)
  
kable(NumLegalStats_TABLE_appendix,
      digits = 1,
      col.names = c("FixedLocationID", "Project", "N", "Station Name", "Reef Acreage",
      "Raw Mean Density (Legal)", "Raw SD (Legal)",
      "Modeled Mean Density (Legal)", "LCL 95% (Legal)", "UCL 95% (Legal)"),
      caption = "Raw and Modeled Mean Densities of Legal-sized oysters on reefs sampled in 2024. Density is expressed in number of legal-sized oysters per square meter. N = Number of quadrats collected, SD = Standard deviation. LCL = Lower confidence limit. UCL = Upper confidence limit. NA indicates means were not modeled. Reefs with a raw mean density at or below 8 per square meter were not modeled. ")
```
